title: Alcohol Ink Clipart MILA
author: Tara Artisan
description:
Alcohol Ink Clipart MILA  digital collection is a beautiful overlays set inspired with alcohol ink paint and glitter shapes. They will stand out beautifully against dark or light backgrounds.
You will receive:
– 9 PNG overlays with transparent background,
– size 8” x 8” (20 cm x 20 cm) and 6”(15 cm) in greatest measure,
– High quality 300 DPI files.
Use them for web decor, branding, product packaging, fabric design, or any of your creative works!
